source_clause: R1HVS1.1) On vehicles that are equipped with the seat zone feature without a hard control or capacitive control there will be a soft button to control this feature in the comfort screen. There are 3 states (1. both seat back and seat cushion, 2. Seat back only 3. Seat cushion only), plus a greyed out state in case heated and vented seats are off.
reasoning: 驗證目標：11.6.1（R1HVS1.1）以兩句定出無硬控之車輛以軟鍵控制座椅分區、其三態與灰化態，兩個 037 leaf 對應之。關鍵情境條件：起始 PC 取本節自帶之限定語（「equipped with the seat zone feature **without a hard control or capacitive control**」）—— **此為 §8.5 之條文自帶觸發條件，非新軸**（形態同 2.9 之「if this feature available」）；依 **R-C34** 四軸中三者暴露 → 補，第十二軸亦補。為什麼這樣切：三態之循環（`060-01`）取狀態轉換法，灰化（`060-02`）之觸發為座椅關閉，兩者失效形態不同。刻意略過：**本節與 `11.7` 之三態循環重疊** —— `11.6.1` 定其「有哪三態」，`11.7` 定其「按下時如何前進與其 popup」，故兩者各自成條（§4.6 見 `distinguishing_axis`）。

distinguishing_axis.axis: 同一功能之「有哪些狀態」與「如何前進」之別
distinguishing_axis.delta: `11.6.1`（R1HVS1.1）定座椅分區軟鍵之**三態集合**與灰化態，`11.7`（R1HVS1.2）定其**按壓之前進方式、popup 與其標籤**。§10.6 之 trigger 與 verification target 皆異 → 非等價；其重疊屬 §4.6 而非 §4.5

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: comfort screen 之座椅分區軟鍵（三態與灰化）
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: **暴露 → 全數補（本組首次以排除式使用第十二軸）** —— 座椅控制位於 comfort category 之 Seats 分頁，2.1 使 tabs 於僅前排氣候之車輛不顯示
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **排除補並逐條答（R-C36-1）** —— 逐條之答皆為 `no`：ch16 無加熱／通風座椅之行為節（僅 16.16 之座椅 off icon，其 leaf 已停下），見 DR #41 之形態

tcs.tc_title: The seat zone soft button offers three states
tcs.test_item: The system shall provide a soft button in the comfort screen with 3 states: both seat back and seat cushion, seat back only, and seat cushion only
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with the seat zone feature without a hard control or capacitive control, for which a soft button controls it (11.6.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the seat zone soft button in the comfort screen
2. Press the seat zone soft button again
3. Press the seat zone soft button again
tcs.expected_result:
1. Both the seat back and the seat cushion are active
2. Only the seat back is active
3. Only the seat cushion is active

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節中僅 `16.16`（ICE15）提及座椅圖示（「Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration」，其 leaf `122-02` 已停下），**無一節定義加熱／通風座椅、加熱方向盤或座椅分區之按壓循環、層級呈現或其 popup**；故本條之 EMEA 排除**無 ch16 對造句可依**，屬 R-C36-1 之過嚴側（同 DR #41 之形態）

tcs.tc_title: The seat zone soft button is greyed out when the seats are off
tcs.test_item: The system shall show a greyed out state in case heated and vented seats are off
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with the seat zone feature without a hard control or capacitive control, for which a soft button controls it (11.6.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the heated and vented seats off
2. Read the seat zone soft button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The heated and vented seats are off
2. The seat zone soft button is greyed out
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
